description: Step I (owner, 25 Nov 2026): the Lantern Festival on 100 squares with the v3 rules (GCD §8.2a R1-R20, docs/prompts/StepI_destinations.md Part 2). Phase B fills in the owner-approved texts and pictures area by area: per square title, guide (Mr. Lin's story, people only), icon, note (own notification); per area icon, announce (owner, 26 Nov 2026: one text with a saying that also tells the area effect; effectText only if a separate effect text is ever needed); notes (notification patterns, {p} = player, {q} = other player, {n} = distance); landmarks; moments. 'name' is a working label, never shown to players. Not used by the app until phase C.

areas.name: Home Town
areas.announce: Welcome, traveller. I am Mr. Lin, and I will guide you on the long road to the Lantern Festival.

areas.name: Countryside
areas.announce: In the Countryside they say, "Even a sheet of paper is lighter when lifted together." The farmers let you cross 6 fields, so roll again and add the free 6 to your roll.

areas.name: Forest
areas.announce: In the Forest, the paths twist and turn, and as the old proverb says, "Take one step back, and the sea and sky open up." Whatever you roll next, you will go backward, and then you will find the right path.

areas.name: Mountains
areas.announce: Welcome to the Mountains! As the proverb says, "No matter how tall the mountain is, it cannot block the sun," so your next roll counts double.

areas.name: Seaside
areas.announce: At the Seaside they say, "The waves behind push the waves ahead." If the next traveller ahead is within twenty squares, you change places; if not, the sea brings you a Bonus card.

areas.name: Big City
areas.announce: In the Big City they say, "Haste does not bring success." If a traveller is within ten squares behind you, you change places; if not, you rest and lose your next turn.

7.name: The Candle Walk
7.title: The Candle Walk
7.guide: By old custom, a traveller to the Lantern Festival carries a lit candle in a paper lantern to the end of their street. Walk slowly, so the flame stays alight.

10.name: lift
10.title: A Farmer's Lift
10.guide: A farmer is driving to market and offers you a seat on the trailer. You accept with thanks.

17.name: hay cart
17.title: The Hay Cart
17.guide: A hay cart is heading for the forest, and the driver waves you aboard. The road is bumpy, but the cart never stops.

20.name: The Village Bus
20.title: The Village Bus
20.guide: The village bus is just leaving, and there is one seat left. The driver knows the old road around the fallen tree.

27.name: The fallen tree
27.title: The Fallen Tree
27.guide: A great tree has fallen across the path. We cannot climb it, so we wait until you roll a 6.

30.name: Bonus card
30.title: The Ranger's Gift
30.guide: A forest ranger shares a cup of tea with you and hands you a Bonus card for the road. It may help you out of trouble one day.

32.name: next good square
32.title: A Path Between the Trees
32.guide: A girl collecting chestnuts shows you a narrow path between the trees. It comes out further along the road.

37.name: Plot Twist (owner, 26 Nov 2026: when nobody is ahead, no guide text, only notes.swapLeaderNone)
37.title: Plot Twist
37.guide: The paths cross in the mist. When it clears, you and the leader have changed places.

40.name: Cable car
40.title: The Cable Car
40.guide: The cable car glides over the pine trees, all the way up to the Mountain Lodge. Far below, the road looks very small.

45.name: Bonus card
45.title: The Tea Picker's Gift
45.guide: On the high tea terraces, a tea picker stops to greet you. She gives you a Bonus card for the journey.

49.name: The Rockslide
49.title: The Rockslide
49.guide: Stones come tumbling down onto the path, and the way up is closed. The only safe road leads back down to the forest.

54.name: ride to the sea
54.title: A Ride to the Sea
54.guide: A family on their way to the seaside has room for one more in the car. You squeeze in next to the picnic basket.

61.name: throw 3 times
61.title: Skipping Stones
61.guide: You find three flat stones on the beach and skip them across the water. The further they bounce, the further you go.

66.name: booking
66.title: What Booking?
66.guide: Your room at the seaside inn was booked for last week. The nearest free bed is back at Base Camp.

69.name: The Dragon Boat
69.title: The Dragon Boat
69.guide: A dragon boat crew is training on the water, and they have a seat for you. They row you all the way to the festival pier.

72.name: others double
72.title: Ice Cream Break
72.guide: The ice cream at the beach stall is too good to rush. While you enjoy it, the other travellers hurry on.

74.name: The Storm
74.title: The Storm
74.guide: Dark clouds roll in from the sea, and the wind blows hard. You run back along the beach to take shelter.

79.name: The Swap Market
79.title: The Swap Market
79.guide: At the Swap Market, travellers trade what they carry. If you have a Bonus card, you give one away; if you have none, someone shares theirs.

85.name: Bonus card
85.title: The Lantern Maker's Gift
85.guide: You help a lantern maker hang her lanterns along the street. To thank you, she gives you a Bonus card.

91.name: Asleep on the Train
91.title: Asleep on the Train
91.guide: The train is warm and quiet, and your eyes close for a moment. You wake up back at the seaside.

94.name: train back
94.title: Missed Your Stop
94.guide: You were watching the city lights and missed your stop. The train takes you back to the edge of the city.

96.name: flame out (owner, 26 Nov 2026: was forgot keys)
96.title: The Flame Goes Out
96.guide: A gust of wind blows out the flame in your paper lantern. You walk back to the lamps of Central Station to light it again.

99.name: lantern torn, miss 2 turns (owner, 26 Nov 2026: was keys AGAIN)
99.title: Out Again!
99.guide: The wind blows your flame out once more, and this time it destroys the lantern too. You shelter at Central Station again, but no shop is open, so you wait two turns to buy a new lantern and light it.

100.name: back (everyone)
100.title: The Lantern Parade
100.guide: A lantern parade fills the street, and the crowd carries you back the way you came. Walk with them and enjoy the lights.

notes.cardCancel: {p} uses a Bonus card: no punishment.
notes.nearest: {p}: forward to the next green square.
notes.rollSum: {p}: 3 rolls, one move by the total.
notes.doubleOthers: Everyone else's next roll counts double.
notes.tree: {p} is stuck at the fallen tree.
notes.dragonBoat: {p} rides the Dragon Boat: next roll needs a 4.
notes.free: {p} is free to go: roll to move.

home.title: Home
home.guide: Your bags are packed and the door is locked. The festival is waiting.

backHome.guide: Back Home, but your bags are still packed. Nothing keeps you here for long.
backHome.note: {p} is Home: no 6 needed to leave.

freeToGo.guide: The road is open, and the festival is waiting.

treeStuck.guide: The tree is still there. Perhaps today we find a way around.

boatWait.guide: The festival lights are close now. Roll exactly 4 to step ashore; any other number, and the boat takes you back.

boatMiss.guide: The current turns, and the crew must row back. You will reach the shore another day.

boatWin.guide: You step ashore at the festival pier, right on time. The crew raise their paddles to wish you well.

finish.guide: You have arrived, {p}, and the night is full of lantern light. Thank you for travelling with me.
